2027-07-03.title: Dukrono of St Thomas the Apostle
readings: I am the way, and the truth, and the life
Go from your country to the land I will show you
The path of the righteous is like the light of dawn
Oh, that I knew where I might find him
How beautiful are the feet of the messenger
Live as free people, as servants of God
In Christ Jesus I became your father through the gospel
2027-07-03.verse: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”

2027-07-04.title: Seventh Sunday after Pentecost
readings: By your words you will be justified
The glory has departed from Israel
Their deeds do not permit them to return
Peace, peace, to the far and the near
The place was shaken; they spoke the word with boldness
He is our peace; the dividing wall broken down
A house divided against itself cannot stand
2027-07-04.verse: If a house is divided against itself, that house will not be able to stand.

2027-07-11.title: Eighth Sunday after Pentecost
readings: Let anyone with ears to hear listen
Oh, that I knew where I might find him
Obey my voice, and I will be your God
My servants shall sing for gladness of heart
A chosen race, a royal priesthood
The word of God is living and active
Those who hear the word and accept it bear fruit
2027-07-11.verse: Indeed, the word of God is living and active, sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing until it divides soul from spirit, joints from marrow; it is able to judge the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

2027-07-15.title: Commemoration of Archbishop Mar Ivanios
readings: Well done, good and trustworthy slave
Moses, the servant of the Lord, died there
Keep watch over the flock; it is more blessed to give
Remember your leaders; imitate their faith
2027-07-15.verse: Remember your leaders, those who spoke the word of God to you; consider the outcome of their way of life, and imitate their faith.

2027-07-18.title: Ninth Sunday after Pentecost
readings: Wheat and weeds; mustard seed; yeast
Keep the statutes, for this is your wisdom
Do not associate with the proud
The earth lies polluted; they have broken the covenant
Paul arrives in Rome and takes courage
Those who humble themselves will be exalted
2027-07-18.verse: For all who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.

2027-07-25.title: Tenth Sunday after Pentecost
readings: They all ate and were filled
I am the Lord who heals you
The Lord restored the fortunes of Job
Happy are those who fear the Lord
Paul teaches about the kingdom of God
If you confess with your lips that Jesus is Lord
2027-07-25.verse: Truly I tell you, unless you change and become like children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.

2027-07-01.title: Thursday of the sixth week after Pentecost · Aaron the High Priest
readings: Every high priest is chosen from among mortals and takes the honour only when called by God, just as Aaron was
Zechariah the priest and Elizabeth, a descendant of Aaron; the whole assembly prays outside at the hour of incense
2027-07-01.verse: And one does not presume to take this honor, but takes it only when called by God, just as Aaron was.

2027-07-02.title: Friday of the sixth week after Pentecost · First Friday
readings: The churches of Macedonia gave themselves first to the Lord: abundant joy and extreme poverty overflowing in generosity
“I have shown you many good works from the Father”: believe the works, that the Father is in me and I am in the Father
2027-07-02.verse: so that you may know and understand that the Father is in me and I am in the Father.

2027-07-05.title: The Seventy-two Heralds · Monday of the seventh week after Pentecost
readings: The weapons of our warfare have divine power; authority given for building up and not for tearing down
The Lord sends out the seventy-two ahead of him in pairs: the harvest is plentiful, the laborers are few, “Peace to this house!”
2027-07-05.verse: The harvest is plentiful, but the laborers are few; therefore ask the Lord of the harvest to send out laborers into his harvest.

2027-07-06.title: Tuesday of the seventh week after Pentecost · Pulikkottil Joseph Ramban · St Maria Goretti
readings: Remember your leaders and imitate their faith; Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever; we have an altar; a sacrifice of praise
The faithful and wise slave whom the master finds at work when he arrives
2027-07-06.verse: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

2027-07-07.title: Wednesday of the seventh week after Pentecost
readings: A divine jealousy: betrothed to one husband, to be presented to Christ; beware of another Jesus
“Let us go to Judea again”: Lazarus has fallen asleep, and Thomas says, “Let us also go, that we may die with him”
2027-07-07.verse: Let us also go, that we may die with him.

2027-07-08.title: Thursday of the seventh week after Pentecost
readings: “Welcome him as you would welcome me”: Paul pleads for Onesimus and takes his debt on his own account
The disciples forget to bring bread: “Do you not remember the five loaves?” Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees
2027-07-08.verse: So if you consider me your partner, welcome him as you would welcome me.

2027-07-09.title: Friday of the seventh week after Pentecost
readings: God has shown mercy to all: “O the depth of the riches and wisdom and knowledge of God!”
Jesus is hungry and finds a fig tree with leaves but no fruit
2027-07-09.verse: For from him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory forever. Amen.

2027-07-10.title: Saturday of the seventh week after Pentecost
readings: Have they stumbled so as to fall? By no means! If the root is holy, then the branches also are holy
Coming down from the mountain, Jesus heals the only son of a desperate father
2027-07-10.verse: If the part of the dough offered as first fruits is holy, then the whole batch is holy; and if the root is holy, then the branches also are holy.

2027-07-12.title: Monday of the eighth week after Pentecost
readings: Paul's ministry was a burden to no one; beware of those who disguise themselves as apostles of Christ
“Follow me, and I will make you fish for people”: the first four disciples leave their nets
2027-07-12.verse: And he said to them, “Follow me, and I will make you fish for people.”

2027-07-13.title: Tuesday of the eighth week after Pentecost · Mar Sheelas
readings: “We are the Lord's”: none of us lives or dies to himself or herself
The harvest is plentiful, but the laborers are few: ask the Lord of the harvest
2027-07-13.verse: If we live, we live to the Lord, and if we die, we die to the Lord; so then, whether we live or whether we die, we are the Lord's.

2027-07-14.title: Wednesday of the eighth week after Pentecost
readings: I planted, Apollos watered, but God gave the growth: you are God's field, God's building
Two blind men cry, “Have mercy on us, Son of David!” and Jesus says, “According to your faith let it be done to you”
2027-07-14.verse: I planted, Apollos watered, but God gave the growth.

2027-07-16.title: Our Lady of Mount Carmel · Friday of the eighth week after Pentecost
readings: God sent his Son, born of a woman: no longer a slave but a child, and an heir
“Blessed is the womb that bore you!” “Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it!”
2027-07-16.verse: But he said, “Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it!”

2027-07-17.title: Saturday of the eighth week after Pentecost · St Alexius of Rome
readings: Thanks be to God, who spreads through us in every place the fragrance that comes from knowing Christ
“The Spirit of the Lord is upon me”: good news to the poor, in the synagogue at Nazareth
2027-07-17.verse: For we are the aroma of Christ to God among those who are being saved and among those who are perishing;

2027-07-19.title: Monday of the ninth week after Pentecost · Morth Makrina
readings: The mystery of lawlessness is already at work; the Lord Jesus will destroy it; the love of the truth that saves
The Pharisees ask for a sign from heaven: “no sign will be given to this generation”
2027-07-19.verse: Why does this generation ask for a sign? Truly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.

2027-07-20.title: Elijah the Prophet · Tuesday of the ninth week after Pentecost
readings: These are only a shadow of what is to come, but the substance belongs to Christ
“Elijah has come”: the question of the disciples as they came down from the mountain
2027-07-20.verse: Elijah is indeed coming first to restore all things.

2027-07-21.title: Daniel the Prophet · Wednesday of the ninth week after Pentecost
readings: We who are strong ought to put up with the failings of the weak; the scriptures give steadfastness, encouragement and hope
The mustard seed and the yeast: the kingdom of heaven small, hidden and growing
2027-07-21.verse: I will open my mouth to speak in parables; I will proclaim what has been hidden from the foundation of the world.

2027-07-22.title: St Mary Magdalene · Thursday of the ninth week after Pentecost
readings: If anyone is in Christ, there is a new creation: God has given us the ministry of reconciliation
Mary Magdalene at the tomb: “Mary!” “Rabbouni!” and “I have seen the Lord”
2027-07-22.verse: Mary Magdalene went and announced to the disciples, “I have seen the Lord”; and she told them that he had said these things to her.

2027-07-23.title: Ezekiel the Prophet · Friday of the ninth week after Pentecost
readings: He has rescued us from the power of darkness and transferred us into the kingdom of his beloved Son
“The one who endures to the end will be saved”: the beginning of the birth pangs and the good news to all nations
2027-07-23.verse: But the one who endures to the end will be saved.

2027-07-24.title: Saturday of the ninth week after Pentecost · St Sharbel
readings: With unveiled faces we are being transformed into the image of the Lord
The Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head: follow me, and do not look back
2027-07-24.verse: all of us, with unveiled faces, seeing the glory of the Lord as though reflected in a mirror, are being transformed into the same image from one degree of glory to another;

2027-07-26.title: Monday of the tenth week after Pentecost
readings: Godly grief produces a repentance that leads to salvation and brings no regret
“Jerusalem, Jerusalem”: Jesus longs to gather her children as a hen gathers her brood under her wings
2027-07-26.verse: For godly grief produces a repentance that leads to salvation and brings no regret, but worldly grief produces death.

2027-07-27.title: Tuesday of the tenth week after Pentecost
readings: We walk by faith, not by sight, and make it our aim to please the Lord
The barren fig tree: the gardener asks for one more year
2027-07-27.verse: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

2027-07-28.title: Wednesday of the tenth week after Pentecost · Morth Alphonsa
readings: “It is no longer I who live, but it is Christ who lives in me”
Unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains just a single grain
2027-07-28.verse: I have been crucified with Christ; and it is no longer I who live, but it is Christ who lives in me.

2027-07-29.title: Thursday of the tenth week after Pentecost · Martha, Mary and Lazarus of Bethany
readings: Let mutual love continue: do not neglect hospitality to strangers
Martha welcomes Jesus into her home, and Mary sits at his feet
2027-07-29.verse: Mary has chosen the better part, which will not be taken away from her.

2027-07-30.title: Friday of the tenth week after Pentecost
readings: You are children of the light and of the day: let us keep awake and be sober
At daybreak Jesus goes to a deserted place, and then goes on to proclaim the kingdom to other cities
2027-07-30.verse: for you are all children of light and children of the day; we are not of the night or of darkness.

2027-07-31.title: Saturday of the tenth week after Pentecost · St Ignatius of Loyola
readings: Do everything for the glory of God; be imitators of me, as I am of Christ
Whoever does not carry the cross and follow me cannot be my disciple: first count the cost
2027-07-31.verse: So, whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do everything for the glory of God.

kidsaint: The little cloud over the sea
The big sister who taught everyone
The prophet and the little cloud
The young man and the lions
The first to say, I have seen the Lord
The soldier who read about Jesus
